title: JANUS Structural Lambda — ROOSTERS Independent Fingerprint Epoch Stability Gate

janus_structural_lambda.reason: Only 31 samples; top two long-period modes have nearly equal spectral power.

local_improvement_pulse.interpretation: secondary rhythm of Delta improvement/stagnation, not a physical wave

roosters_validation_plan.target: Test whether the 11–17 generation structural wavelength band persists across independent JANUS geometries.
frozen_pipeline_per_epoch: collect a sufficiently long uniformly sampled trace
record exact fingerprint epoch and construction family
remove trend using the same preregistered detrending rule
compute the same discrete Fourier power spectrum
extract dominant long-period band and local pulse modes
store full spectrum and not only the winning peak
never use current epoch result to change current epoch spectral method

candidate_support_rule.support_if: Independent epochs repeatedly place a dominant or high-power long-period mode inside 11–17 generations under the frozen pipeline.
candidate_support_rule.do_not_promote_if: Only one construction family or repeated mutations of one fingerprint lineage reproduce the band.
candidate_support_rule.refute_or_widen_if: Independent epochs systematically peak outside 11–17 or the band is unstable under preregistered robustness checks.

robustness_checks: compare quadratic detrend with at least one preregistered alternative without choosing post hoc
report spectral resolution imposed by trace length
test whether long-period peak survives removal of isolated improvement spikes
keep Delta, Gamma and successor traces separate before any cross-signal synthesis

interpretation_if_replicated.allowed: Candidate characteristic structural timescale of JANUS search/adaptation dynamics in units of generations.
forbidden: calling it a physical wavelength in meters
calling it a universal constant after finite tests
using spectral recurrence as theorem authority
inferring P=NP or any complexity-class result from the observed band

relationship_to_roosters_v5_1.purpose: Convert an interesting single-run FFT pattern into a falsifiable multi-epoch hypothesis instead of a self-confirming narrative.

next_gate.name: ROOSTERS_MULTI_EPOCH_STRUCTURAL_LAMBDA_STABILITY_GATE
next_gate.question: Does the 11–17 generation band survive across independent fingerprint epochs and distinct geometries?
